title: Create+ Neo
description: A Create-centric modpack packed with addons, visual enhancements, and quality-of-life mods for an immersive factory-building experience on NeoForge 1.21.1.
body:
🏭 Create+ Neo

A Create-focused modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 on NeoForge, built around 
the art of automation, engineering, and exploration.

   ⚙️ What to Expect

- Massive Create addon support — including Big Cannons, Jetpack, Slice & Dice, 
  Enchantment Industry, Diesel Generators, and many more
- Stunning visuals — powered by Complementary Shaders (Reimagined & Unbound) 
  and Iris for a beautiful world
- Quality of life — JEI, Xaero's Minimap & World Map, Jade, Inventorio, 
  Sophisticated Backpacks, and more to keep your experience smooth

   🛠️ Built for Builders & Engineers

Whether you're automating your first farm or constructing a continent-spanning 
factory network, Create+ Neo has everything you need to make it happen.
